title: How Hej Home Decor landed a $700 order with AI video ad maker
summary: One video post won Hej Home Decor a $700 order, nearly double its usual. See how Nandini makes Instagram ads in minutes with an AI video ad maker.
body_markdown:
Hej Home Decor, a London-based home decor brand, uses Photoroom’s AI video ad maker to turn product photos into Instagram video ads. Founder Nandini operates the business mostly on her own and sells candles, trays, and tabletop accessories mainly to the Indian market. She needed video to grow, but shoots in India were costly and could only happen once or twice a year. With Product Staging and Video Ad Maker, she now makes 2 to 3 videos in 15 to 20 minutes instead of spending 7 to 8 hours with a photographer. Reach to non-followers rose from 20% to 60%, and one video post brought in a $700 order from a non-follower, nearly double her usual order.


## Life before Photoroom


-


Photographers charged £100–150/hour, videographers charged nearly double


-


Finding, briefing, and working with a photographer took 7 to 8 hours


-


Posts reach 20% non-followers, limiting growth


-


The average B2B order value was $300 - $400


## Life after Photoroom


-


Nandini pays one monthly rate for Photoroom’s Max plan


-


2 to 3 videos take 15 to 20 minutes to make


-


Videos reach 60% non-followers and 40% followers


-


One video generated $700 in sales from a single order


## When video becomes necessary


Nandini’s brand Hej Home Decor sells candles, trays, and other decorative home items. Most of Hej Home Decor’s sales come from cold B2B outreach to other shops. Now Nandini wants buyers to find her instead. Her plan is to build a strong online presence over the next six to seven months.


> “Until I call people up, they don’t know about my brand or the products I sell.” — Nandini, Founder of Hej Home Decor


Building that presence requires creating content for Instagram. But with her products located in India, London-based Nandini can only capture content once or twice a year. Photo and video shoots are expensive, too. Photographers in India charge £100–150/hour, and working with one takes 7 to 8 hours. Videographers charge nearly double. For a small business like hers, video ads can feel out of reach.


She’s not alone. Without an in-house photography team,[luxury reseller Blazendary was losing sales to listings with no images](https://www.photoroom.com/customer-stories/blazendary) until it switched to Photoroom.


## Finding the right AI video ad maker


It wasn’t until a friend introduced her to Photoroom that Nandini started to consider AI as a solution.


She started with[Product Staging](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/product-staging) to create realistic lifestyle scenes from her existing product photos. Then she used[Video Ad Maker](https://www.photoroom.com/tools/video-generator/ad-maker) to generate 6 to 7 videos. The results were Instagram ready: realistic, on-brand, and focused on the product.


Nandini knows that customers want to visualize products in their own home. Video helps with that. And with Photoroom, she’s able to generate multiple assets at a time for a fraction of the cost and effort.


## How Nandini turns product photos into social ready videos with Video Ad Maker


Nandini knew Photoroom’s Video Ad Maker was working when an AI generated video ad led to a $700 order, nearly double her average order value of $300 to $400.


Her products are getting in front of a broader audience, too. The video ads she creates with Photoroom reach 60% non-followers, compared to 20% previously. That’s the real payoff of Instagram video ads for small businesses: reaching buyers who don’t follow you yet.


Here’s how she does it.


### Start with a product photo


Nandini uploads her existing product photos to Photoroom. Video Ad Maker and Product Staging both allow for up to 6 reference photos.


### Product Staging


Product Staging turns product visuals into realistic lifestyle scenes. Photoroom is specifically built for e‑commerce. That means Nandini can type in a prompt or let Photoroom’s AI choose a suitable scene for her product.


For past photoshoots, Nandini would have to purchase the right props and find a location remotely from London. Today, Nandini simply prompts the AI to use the background and props she wants in the scene.


That’s especially valuable for peak selling seasons, like Black Friday, Diwali, and Christmas.


> “The best part is now I don’t have to worry about props, be it any season. I just tweak the prompt and the same product feels very different.”— Nandini, Founder of Hej Home Decor


### Video Ad Maker


Video Ad Maker is an AI video generator from images: it turns product photos into 5 to 10 second video ads. Sellers can write their own prompts, or answer questions from an AI Director about the video’s style, tone, and script. With Photoroom’s Max plan and Video Ad Maker, Nandini turns a single asset into multiple unique videos featuring seasonal props and settings.


### Share on Instagram


Once Nandini generates her videos, she adds her own music and posts them straight to Instagram.


## The future of video with Photoroom


Photoroom’s Video Ad Maker has created new opportunities for Nandini to create content and reach new customers.


> “I think my social media page would be dead without this tool.” — Nandini, Founder of Hej Home Decor


As Nandini’s business grows, so does her need for strong, on-brand creative. With Video Ad Maker, video content isn’t a blocker, it’s a revenue driver.
